scheme_name: Scheme of Encouragement to Young Artists
other_conditions: Must be a domicile of Tamil Nadu
Age must be above 16 years and within 30 years for music artists
Age must be over 15 years and within 30 years for Bharatanatyam artists

Must participate in any one of the following performances: Vocal, Bharatanatyam, Kathakalakshepam, Veena, Violin (solo), Nadaswaram, Flute, Jalatharangam, Gottuvadhyam, Clarinet, Guitar, Mandolin, Saxophone
Artists already selected in one discipline can apply for another as well
benefits_summary: Remuneration ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹10,000 per performance.
